dynamic_classification.moving_rigid: exact F001/I001 selected instance, fixed before warmup and unchanged through measured target frame
dynamic_classification.stable_cases: no dynamic subset; full scene remains persistent static HWRT

builder.current_frame_generation: GPU translation inside measured builder input phase
builder.macro_key: Morton 10 bits per axis, 30 bits total
builder.local_key: Morton of 0..7 local coordinates, 9 significant bits
builder.radix_order: 3 local-key passes then 8 macro-key passes; stable LSD
builder.pair_capacity_rule: sum over frozen dynamic source triangles of product(ceil(axis_aabb_extent/local_cell_extent)+2); translation preserves extents; overflow is correctness failure
builder.prefix: GPU serial exact exclusive scan for Nrep control architecture
builder.ranges: GPU RLE after sort into cell ranges and macro ranges

dynamic_traversal.lookup: binary search sorted macro ranges and local cell ranges
dynamic_traversal.duplicate_references: allowed across overlapped cells; nearest/tie contract resolves repeated primitive tests

merge.policy: nearest static/dynamic Hit with shared absolute/relative tolerance and lower primitive_id tie break

accepted_timing.decision_statistic: median of process-level measured target frames
